# System Collections Reference

<!-- Generated by SystemCollectionsReferenceTest from SystemCollectionDefinitions.all().
     Do not edit by hand: change the definition, then run
     mvn -f kelta-platform/pom.xml -pl runtime/runtime-core test -Dtest=SystemCollectionsReferenceTest -Dkelta.docs.write=true -->

Every system collection the platform defines — the metadata behind collections, fields, users,
security, UI, flows and audit — generated from the runtime's system-collection registry.
Each is served like a user collection at its API path (JSON:API, see
[JSON:API Conventions](/docs/reference/jsonapi/)), and
`GET /api/collections/{name}/schema` describes its fields.

- **Tenant-scoped** — rows belong to one tenant and are isolated by row-level security.
- **Read-only** — the API serves reads only (audit logs, history, platform-written data).
- **Key fields** — the display field, then every required field.

95 system collections, sorted by name.
